svg.text: The two-stage wait that dispatches request i at its intended time t_i
Each worker targets its own absolute t_i, so pacer jitter inside the 10 ms lead does not delay the send, and one late wake-up
does not accumulate across later requests. A worker spawned after t_i - 1.5 ms skips the timer; one spawned after t_i sends at once.
